evals.prompt: Write the test plan and Gherkin scenarios from docs/PRD.md. Nobody is available to answer questions right now.
evals.expected_output: docs/TEST-PLAN.md with Verification Criteria for BAC-1 to BAC-12, every section 9 NFR, the No outside email Non-Negotiable and CONSTRAINTS.md N-1 to N-4, a coverage matrix, and tests/features/*.feature files (one per capability: F1, F2 and the Leadership-and-admin FR group) tagged with FR, BAC and VC IDs; email timing tested at the PRD's 'by 09:00' with the architecture's 10:00 raised as a question for the architect; the 'relevant day' resolved through FR-4, FR-7 and FR-8; no source file changed; Status exactly Ready for review; the checklist reported per item, T1 to T15. (Mini fixture; the full-size run is soak eval 4.)
expectations: Every VC either links to at least one scenario by tag, or is marked Manual, Tool check or Non-functional with a stated reason why it is not a scenario

tests/features/ has one .feature file per capability: one for flow F1 (Schedule a QBR), one for flow F2 (Record a QBR and work its action items) and one for the Leadership-and-admin FR group (FR-9, FR-10) that no flow uses; a separate file for the No outside email Non-Negotiable is allowed. Not a single file, and not one file per BAC
The BAC-2 scenario uses the PRD's example: held 2026-01-10 gives a due date of 2026-04-10 for Tier 1, 2026-07-09 for Tier 2 and 2027-01-10 for Tier 3
The No outside email Non-Negotiable and each of CONSTRAINTS.md N-1 to N-4, including the N-4 mass-change guard that only the ADR states, has at least one VC with an observable pass/fail condition

Each PRD section 9 NFR has a VC carrying the PRD's target (24-hour data freshness, emails by 09:00 in the recipient's time zone with IST fallback, IST fallback for time display, 95% of page loads within 2 seconds at 300 users and 200 accounts) or an ADR's tighter value for it (the 6-hourly CRM sync for the 24-hour freshness target), or is marked Manual or Non-functional with a reason; only a VC that uses a value looser than the PRD's target fails

Email-timing VCs and scenarios use the PRD's 'by 09:00', not the architecture's 10:00 send time, AND TEST-PLAN.md's open questions contain a row raising the 10:00 versus 09:00 conflict, owned by the architect, citing the PRD's email-timing NFR; both parts are required

The email-timing NFR is not marked untestable: its 'relevant day' is resolved through the FRs it lists (FR-4: 7 days and 1 day before the QBR; FR-7: the first day after the due date; FR-8: the day after the change is first seen), and its VCs or scenarios use concrete dates
Integration VCs use the architecture's test doubles (fake CRM, fake directory, captured outbox, fixed clock), and no VC needs a live CRM, directory or mail relay to pass
No VC tests behaviour the PRD rules out or doesn't ask for, such as writing to the CRM, mobile layouts, or sending email to addresses outside Larkspur as a feature

checks.text: docs/TEST-PLAN.md exists with sections for the test strategy, the Verification Criteria, a coverage matrix, quality gates and open questions
Every BAC from BAC-1 to BAC-12 appears in the coverage matrix with at least one VC

Every scenario carries a @VC- tag and at least one proof tag (@BAC- with @FR-, @NN-, @N-, @NFR- or @EDGE-), and every tagged ID exists in the PRD (an @EDGE-n numbered in its section 10), CONSTRAINTS.md or the test plan's VC table

The coverage matrix and the feature tags agree: every Covered VC has a tagged scenario (Tool check, Manual and Non-functional VCs need none), no scenario is tagged with a Blocked or Withdrawn VC, and each scenario's BAC and VC tags match the matrix
No step contains a URL, HTTP verb, endpoint, status code, UI selector or a technology the architecture names
docs/PRD.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, every file in docs/adr/ and CONSTRAINTS.md are byte-for-byte unchanged
TEST-PLAN.md Status is exactly 'Ready for review' (not Draft, not Approved)
The agent reports the checklist results by item ID, T1 to T15, one line each with pass or fail

BAC-11 (named by OQ 1) and BAC-3 and BAC-4 (via FR-3, named by OQ 2) are Blocked citing their question; the VC for the 'CRM is the source of account data' Non-Negotiable is Blocked citing OQ 3; the vague BAC-7 is Blocked (untestable) and routed to the PRD approver via the BA instead of given an invented threshold; integration VCs such as BAC-1's CRM sync stay Pending architecture; unblocked BACs such as BAC-2 still get VCs and scenarios. expectations: The agent identifies the PRD's Status as In Review before writing, and treats Draft as the highest Status the test plan may have
BAC-7 ('quickly and clearly') gets no invented time threshold or field list; the routed question naming BAC-7 is owned by the PRD approver via the BA

Because there is no docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, test levels and doubles are marked provisional, and the NFR VCs whose pass depends on runtime or infrastructure (Speed, Data freshness and Email timing) are marked Pending architecture, never Covered; the Time display NFR is a pure rule checkable with a fixed clock and no external system, so its VC is functional and may be Covered

VCs that depend on a system the PRD names (the CRM, the company directory, email delivery) are not Covered without an architecture, whatever Level they are given (unit, integration or e2e): BAC-1's CRM sync and the emails of BAC-5, BAC-8 and BAC-9 are Pending architecture or Blocked; functional VCs that depend on no external system, such as BAC-2's due-date rule, may be Covered, and so may access and role VCs (what a signed-in user may see or do) whose scenarios set the user with a signed-in-user stub; only a VC about the sign-in mechanism itself (provider unavailable, session expiry, account disabled in the directory) must wait
